name: Hoi An
provinceNote: Hoi An was in Quang Nam, which merged into Da Nang in 2025. Search and book it as Hoi An.
summary: Sleep in Hoi An when you want the timber streets after dark, the covered bridge at the west end, and the river the houses back onto. Sleep in Da Nang when the morning is the beach. The old town is a walk. The sightseeing fee is check on arrival.
getThere: Da Nang International Airport (DAD), then the road south. The ancient town is about 30 km southeast of Da Nang city. The minutes are check on arrival.
seoTitle: Hoi An travel guide — timber streets and the bridge
seoDescription: The ancient town is about 30 km southeast of Da Nang. From 10 August 2026 the city fee is 20,000 VND a building. Floods are usual in September to November.
intro: The street is a tight row of tiled timber shophouses, with the covered wooden bridge at the west end and the river the houses back onto. Walk it in the morning, then again after the shops thin, inside the pedestrian hours the heritage centre printed in January 2026: 09:00–21:30 in summer and 09:00–21:00 in winter. The notice does not say which months those words cover.

Sleep in the lanes just off that core when the evening is the trip. Sleep in Da Nang when the morning is the beach. An Bang is the Hoi An swim, a villa and homestay base in what is now Hoi An Tây. The ride from the old town is check on arrival. Cửa Đại’s erosion is serious, and the same coast article says An Bang and Tân Thành are also threatened.

The sightseeing fee is check on arrival. From 10 August 2026, Da Nang’s resolution sets 20,000 VND per person per building, the same for a Vietnamese and a foreign visitor. The heritage centre’s notices of 26 January 2026 and 16 March 2026 still describe combination tickets: 80,000 VND for the streetscape, Chùa Cầu or Miếu Quan Công, and two other works, and 120,000 VND when a museum and three other works are added. A May 2026 article says the town is an open neighbourhood and many people walk in without a ticket, and it counts those prices as four works and six. Ask which rule the desk is using that day.
gettingAround: The ancient town is about 30 km southeast of Da Nang city. The minutes from the airport are check on arrival. From the Marble Mountains, the coastal road along Trường Sa–Lạc Long Quân is about 30 minutes. The rail stop is Ga Đà Nẵng, then the road south. The station address and those minutes are check on arrival.

Route 02 runs from Đà Nẵng central station through the Hoi An bus station to the inland-waterway parking at Cửa Đại, from 05:30 to 18:00, every 20–30 minutes. The operator’s December 2025 page gives a fare band of 8,000–30,000 VND, with pupils and students at 8,000 VND. A July 2025 report gives 8,000–48,000 VND across route 02 and route 21. The price at the Hoi An stop, and the ride time, are check on arrival.

Inside the ancient town, walk. The January 2026 notice prints old-town pedestrian hours of 09:00–21:30 in summer and 09:00–21:00 in winter, and Phan Châu Trinh from 17:30 to 21:30 in summer and to 21:00 in winter, between Nguyễn Huệ and Cao Hồng Lãnh. A 2023 notice described a later 15:00 start. The January 2026 notice still prints 17:30. Whether that afternoon start is in force is check on arrival. A bicycle or a ride is the way to An Bang and to Trà Quế, about 2.5 km north on the heritage page and about 2 km northeast on the national tourism page. The minutes are check on arrival.

eat: Cao lầu is tossed while it is hot. People here call it bánh. White rose dumplings are a small warm plate. Chicken rice is the lunch when you want a plate instead of noodles. Bánh mì is the morning stall in the old town.
The food hall is inside Chợ Hội An. The night market is on Nguyễn Hoàng, Công nữ Ngọc Hoa, Trần Quý Cáp, and Bạch Đằng. Hours for both are check on arrival.
interestsBody: Dining is cao lầu tossed while it is hot, white rose dumplings warm, and chicken rice when you want a plate. Mì Quảng is the neighbor’s bowl. The food guide is the first stop.
The night is the timber streets inside the pedestrian hours, and the covered bridge at the west end. That is the reason to sleep here.
Merchant houses such as Tấn Ký are the inside of the street: a shop at the front and the river at the back. The ground floor is the visit.
The assembly halls are the Hoa merchant halls. Quảng Đông is the dragon court. Phúc Kiến is the long hall on Trần Phú. Chùa Ông is at 24 Trần Phú.
The museums are a morning hour: trade ceramics at 80 Trần Phú, Sa Huỳnh pottery at 149 Trần Phú, and the folk-culture house at 33 Nguyễn Thái Học.
Trà Quế is the herb beds about 2.5 km north on the heritage page, and about 2 km northeast on the national tourism page. The greens go into cao lầu.
Kim Bồng is the carpentry village across the river. Thanh Hà is the pottery west of town. Crossing minutes and the ride are check on arrival.
An Bang is the swim and the villa stay, now in Hoi An Tây. Cửa Đại’s erosion is serious, and the same coast article says this beach is threatened too. The ride from the old town is check on arrival.
Cẩm Thanh is the basket-boat hour in the nipa water, about 3 km out on the 2022 article. From 10 August 2026 the entry is 30,000 VND. The boat price is check on arrival.

faqs.q: Should you stay in Hoi An or Da Nang?
faqs.a: Sleep in Hoi An when the timber streets after dark are the reason you came. Sleep in Da Nang when you want the beach in the morning. The ancient town is about 30 km southeast of Da Nang city. The minutes from the airport are check on arrival.

faqs.q: What does the ancient-town ticket cost?
faqs.a: Check on arrival. From 10 August 2026 the city fee is 20,000 VND per person per building, the same for a Vietnamese and a foreign visitor. The heritage centre’s January and March 2026 notices still describe combination tickets of 80,000 VND and 120,000 VND. A May 2026 article says many people walk the open neighbourhood without a ticket.

faqs.q: Is Hoi An worth visiting in October?
faqs.a: Floods are usual from September to November, and the rainy season on the city climate page runs October to December. The town can be open and under water in the same month. If your dates are fixed, keep a Da Nang hotel as the backup and check the road that morning.

season.label: Flood risk Sep–Nov
season.note: The Da Nang city portal, 4 May 2026, calls January to September dry and October to December the rainy season, with floods usual in September to November and storms mainly September to December. Check the Hoi An road on the morning you go.
